thread.title: Close Update: Wall Street Mixed as Financials Lift Dow But Nasdaq Wilts Under Tech Pressure

title: Close Update: Wall Street Mixed as Financials Lift Dow But Nasdaq Wilts Under Tech Pressure
text:
Close Update: Wall Street Mixed as Financials Lift Dow But Nasdaq Wilts Under Tech Pressure January 24, 2018, 04:26:01 PM EDT By MT Newswires, MT Newswires Shutterstock photo 
Wall Street was mixed on Wednesday, with gains in financials propping up the Dow Jones Industrial Average while losses in information technology stocks, the top performing sector over the past year, dragged down the Nasdaq Composite and curbed the S&P 500. 
Stocks struggled to gain traction after U.S. Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross sparked fears of a trade war with China in comments about the Asian nation's 2025 Technology Plan. Financials and telecoms led gains among the S&P groups but declines in heavyweight Apple ( AAPL ) sent the tech group down 0.8% in the steepest loss among the 11 groups. 
Apple lost 1.6% after Canaccord Genuity lowered March quarter iPhone estimates, while reiterating a buy rating. An 8.5% loss in Texas Instruments ( TXN ) also dented the Nasdaq after earnings for the fourth quarter declined due to U.S. tax reform. 
On the Dow, General Electric ( GE ) dropped 2.6% after reporting earnings and a regulatory probe into a multibillion charge that weighed on its fourth quarter results. Goldman Sachs ( GS ) rose 2.1% in the best gain among the blue chips as financials rose 0.7% on the S&P 500. 
in other markets, crude jumped as US inventories contracted for a 10th straight week, while the dollar fell to the lowest level in more than three years against a basket of its counterparts after Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said a weaker dollar is good for trade. 
Here's where the markets stood by the close:

GLOBAL SENTIMENT
